archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.4 Enable Integration and Orchestration Services
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once the core platforms are in place, they must be connected. This step focuses on integration and orchestration — ensuring that data, applications, and services can work together smoothly.
Integration services enable the flow of data between systems using APIs, message queues, or data pipelines. Orchestration tools automate sequences of actions — for example, automatically triggering data validation after ingestion, or sending completed datasets into the next processing stage.
These services form the “nervous system” of the organization’s technical ecosystem — coordinating activities, maintaining consistency, and ensuring efficiency. Without them, systems would remain isolated, and processes would require manual intervention.
Value created: Seamless integration and automation across systems, enabling smooth and consistent data and process flows.
